hooks.command: root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo .)"; bash "$root/hooks/closeout.sh" session-start </dev/null 2>/dev/null || printf '{}'

root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo .)"; pkg="$root/scripts/rally_point"; host_parent="${PPID:-0}"; rally_session="${BUILD_LOOP_RALLY_SESSION_ID:-${CODEX_THREAD_ID:-${RALLY_AGENT_ID:-${RALLY_SESSION_ID:-codex-${host_parent}}}}}"; [ -f "$pkg/session_probe.py" ] && WORKDIR="$root" python3 "$pkg/session_probe.py" --workdir "$root" --tool codex --session-id "$rally_session" --mode hook --start-watch --watch-parent-pid "$host_parent" >/dev/null 2>&1 || printf '{}'
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo .)"; python3 "$root/scripts/tool_trace.py" --workdir "$root" ingest >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; printf '{}'
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo .)"; bash "$root/hooks/closeout.sh" stop 2>/dev/null || printf '{}'

root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo .)"; pkg="$root/scripts/rally_point"; host_parent="${PPID:-0}"; rally_session="${BUILD_LOOP_RALLY_SESSION_ID:-${CODEX_THREAD_ID:-${RALLY_AGENT_ID:-${RALLY_SESSION_ID:-codex-${host_parent}}}}}"; actor="$(python3 "$pkg/actor_identity.py" --tool codex --session-id "$rally_session" 2>/dev/null || true)"; [ -n "$actor" ] && python3 "$root/scripts/agent_rally.py" stop --workdir "$root" --tool "$actor" --session-id "$rally_session" --json >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo .)"; s="$root/scripts/hooks/session_end_retro_sweep.py"; [ -f "$s" ] && nohup python3 "$s" </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 & exit 0
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo .)"; bash "$root/hooks/stop-transcript-sweep.sh" all 2>/dev/null || printf '{}'
